column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_reversi.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module start of rel_reversi: when arg is 0 registers the reversi scene with system_scene_register(world_reversi_scene_main 0x00000038, world_reversi_scene_end 0x000000e4, 0x0000f350). Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point). Same code as rel_shop shop_module_start.

Scene start of the reversi mini-game (scene 0x19): hides the loading overlay, runs world_reversi_init and, when its return register is non-zero (Ghidra types the init as void; hypothesis: the 1 just stored to 0x0000f35c, medium), installs world_reversi_draw_frame (0x174) and the leave callback 0x000001a0, loops world_reversi_update_frame / system_wait_frame until it reports completion, then installs the no-op callbacks, shows the loading overlay, waits a frame and returns from scene 0x19 (system_scene_return(0x19, 0)). No return value. Side effects: the whole mini-game, scene return. No direct caller (registered as the scene start callback by world_reversi_module_start).
Empty scene end callback. No return value. No side effects. No direct caller (registered by world_reversi_module_start).

Sets the thread attribute 0x4000, reads the reversi parameter block (world_get_reversi_params, BOOT 0x08dc170c) and runs world_reversi_init_state(block word 0 = partner character, word 1 = its variant, -1, -1, -1, -1), so words 2-5 of the block are not read here; then sets the draw flag 0x0000f35c. No return value. Side effects: the module state, heap, audio. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_scene_main).
Runs world_reversi_update; when it reports completion clears the draw flag 0x0000f35c. Returns true when finished. Side effects: through the update. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_scene_main).

Frame callback: draws the mini-game (world_reversi_draw) while the draw flag 0x0000f35c is set. No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. No direct caller (installed by world_reversi_scene_main).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00000290; nop) to world_reversi_term. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_reversi_term (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: int world_reversi_init_state(int partner, int partner_variant, int seat2_character, int seat2_variant, int seat3_character, int seat3_variant)
column3: Clears the 0x970-byte module state at 0x0000f360, creates a 2 MiB heap on module memory +0xfcd0 (0x0000f360), clears the state words 0x0000f37c (main state) and 0x0000f380 (load step), stores the partner 0x0000f364/0x0000f368 (the player's teammate), the second seat 0x0000f36c/0x0000f374 and the third seat 0x0000f370/0x0000f378 (-1 = choose later), releases all sound banks and loads tracks 0x2c8, 0x2ca, 0x2d0 and 0x2d5. Arguments 5-6 travel in t0/t1. Returns 1. Side effects: module state, heap, audio banks. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_init).

Frees the module heap 0x0000f360 and releases tracks 0x2c8, 0x2ca, 0x2d0 and 0x2d5. Returns 1. Side effects: frees module memory, audio. No direct caller (hypothesis: reached from the leave callback 0x000001a0, medium).

Main state machine on 0x0000f37c: 0 runs the archive loader (world_reversi_load_archive) and when done runs world_reversi_start_intro, starts a 16-frame white fade in, sets the round counter 0x0000f384 = 1, clears the total score 0x0000f388 and the win counter 0x0000f38c, plays sound 0x7ac6, -> 1; 1 when world_reversi_is_intro_done reports 1 sets up the characters (world_reversi_setup_characters) and the board (world_reversi_setup_board), white fade in, -> 2; 2 when the fade is done starts play (world_reversi_start_play), -> 3; 3 when the game update world_reversi_update_play returns 1 starts a black fade out (and fades the BGM over 1500 when bit 1 of 0x0000f408 requests another round), -> 4; 4 when the fade is done either starts the next round (new characters, new board, fade in, round counter + 1 up to 100, -> 2) or creates the shared result screen with the bound mini_result archive 0x0000f410 and game index 5 and the score block {0x0000f388} (ui_reversi_result_create), -> 5; 5 polls the result screen (ui_reversi_result_update): 3 destroys it -> 6, 2 destroys it -> 0 (play again); 6 releases the archive and reports completion. Returns 1 in state 6, else 0. Side effects: module state, fades, sounds, save (through the result screen). Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_frame).

Resets the GE state (world_reversi_reset_ge_state), then draws by main state: 1 the intro (world_reversi_draw_intro), 2-4 the play screen (world_reversi_draw_game), 5 the result screen into GE layer 4 (ui_reversi_result_draw); in every state except 5 also draws the screen fade on layer 5. No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_frame).

Chooses the characters of a round: when seat 2 (0x0000f36c) is -1 fills it and its variant through world_reversi_pick_random_opponent(0x19, ..., opponent, variant, ..., 0), and when seat 3 (0x0000f370) is -1 through world_reversi_pick_random_opponent(..., 1) seeded with seat 2; stores the result in 0x0000f390/0x0000f394 (the parameter-block character, who plays as the player's partner), 0x0000f398/0x0000f3a0 (seat 2, first opponent) and 0x0000f39c/0x0000f3a4 (seat 3, second opponent) and caches world_get_character_words_58 of the three into 0x0000f3a8, 0x0000f3c8 and 0x0000f3e8. The seat arguments are re-read each round, so -1 seats (always the case, see world_reversi_init) get two new random opponents every round, the second different from the first. No return value. Side effects: module state 0x0000f390..0x0000f407. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).

Archive load step machine on 0x0000f380: 0 starts the load (world_reversi_start_archive_load) -> 1; 1 once the load-done bit 0 of 0x0000f408 is set binds the archive 0x0000f40c as an EHP, finds and binds the nested mini_result archive (world_reversi_bind_result_archive, 0x0000f410), applies the animation TMF flags (world_reversi_apply_anim_tmf) -> 2; 2 is done. Returns 1 when done, else 0. Side effects: archive buffer and bindings, 0x0000f380. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).

Builds the path minigame/reversi/ + the language archive name from the table 0x0000eb14 (lang_jpn.ehp first, indexed by save_get_language), allocates a buffer of its size on the module heap (0x0000f40c), clears the load-done bit 0 of 0x0000f408 and starts container_load_file(root 3, path, buffer, size, world_reversi_on_archive_loaded, 0). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, asynchronous file load. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_load_archive).

File-load completion callback: when size is positive sets the load-done bit 0 of 0x0000f408. Returns size > 0. Side effects: 0x0000f408. No direct caller (passed to container_load_file by world_reversi_start_archive_load).

Runs the EHP extension handlers (unbinding) on the mini_result archive 0x0000f410 and the main archive 0x0000f40c and frees the archive buffer on the module heap. No return value. Side effects: frees the archive. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).

Returns the archive member named by entry index of the pointer table 0x0000e9a0 (mini_rv_bg01.gim first) via container_ehp_find_member (Ghidra drops the return). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_bind_gim, world_reversi_draw_portrait).

For animation indices 0-8 except 6: copies the animation's member name (table 0x0000ea78), replaces the substring found by the 4-byte pattern at 0x0000ebcc with the 5-byte string at 0x0000ebd4 (hypothesis: the .ehf extension becomes the companion .tmf name, medium), finds that member and applies it to the animation (ui_ehf_apply_tmf_flags). No return value. Side effects: the EHF animations' flags. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_load_archive).

Returns the archive member named by entry index of the table 0x0000ea78 (mini_rv_anm01.ehf first, 9 entries) via container_ehp_find_member. No side effects. Callers: 7 (world_reversi_apply_anim_tmf, world_reversi_set_anim_range, world_reversi_draw_anim, world_reversi_draw_intro, ...).
Returns the archive member strTbl.bin (string table) via container_ehp_find_member. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_open_continue_window, world_reversi_draw_score_panel_contents).
Returns the module heap 0x0000f360. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_open_window).

Finds the nested mini_result archive for the current language (name table 0x0000eba4, mini_result_j.ehp first) in archive and binds it as an EHP. Returns its pointer. Side effects: the EHP binding. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_load_archive).
Returns entry size (0-2) of the 3-word table 0x0000ebdc, the gim index used for the portrait atlas of that size (medium). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_portrait).

Clears GE layer 0 (colour, stencil, depth, clear flags 0x17), then writes a default render state on layer 4: enables states 0, 8, 10 and 0x10 and disables 2, 3, 5-7, 0xb-0xf and 0x11-0x15, colour 0, light mode 0, ambient 0, model colours 0, colour material 7, smooth shading, front face 1, texture map mode 0, texture offset 0 and scale 1.0, alpha function (6, 0, 0xff) and depth function 7. No return value. Side effects: GE layers 0 and 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw).

column2: void * field_3d_dl_set_texture_state(void *list, int enable, int min_filter, int mag_filter, int tex_func, int tex_component, int wrap_u, int wrap_v)
column3: When enable is 1 enables GE state 9 (texturing) and writes the texture filter, function, wrap modes, offset 0 and scale 1.0; otherwise disables state 9. Returns the advanced list pointer (Ghidra drops it). Side effects: appends GE commands. Callers: 10 (world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_board, world_reversi_draw_selector_frame, ...). Same code as rel_duel_draw field_3d_dl_set_texture_state.

column2: void * field_3d_dl_set_depth_test(void *list, int enable, uint depth_mask)
column3: When enable is 1 enables GE state 1 (depth test) and writes the depth-write mask; otherwise disables state 1. Returns the advanced list pointer. Side effects: appends GE commands. Callers: 10 (world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_board, world_reversi_draw_selectors, ...). Same code as rel_duel_draw field_3d_dl_set_depth_test.

column2: void * field_3d_dl_set_blend(void *list, int enable, int op, uint src, int dst, uint fix_a, uint fix_b)
column3: When enable is 1 enables GE state 4 (blending) and writes the blend function; otherwise disables state 4. Returns the advanced list pointer. Side effects: appends GE commands. Callers: 10 (world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_board, world_reversi_draw_selectors, ...). Same code as rel_duel_draw field_3d_dl_set_blend.

Binds archive image index (world_reversi_get_gim) as the current texture with field_3d_gim_emit_texture_frame0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 9 (world_reversi_draw_number_large, world_reversi_draw_number_small, world_reversi_draw_portrait, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, ...).

column2: float ui_duel_ease_sine(int frame, int duration, int iterations)
column3: Computes t = clamp(frame, 0, duration) / duration and applies t = sin(K * t) iterations times (K the float at 0x0000e784, probably pi/2, medium), returning t in f0 (Ghidra shows no return). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_selector_frame). Same code as rel_duel_draw ui_duel_ease_sine.

Seeks animation anim (world_reversi_get_anim) to a start frame and sets its play range, chosen from module state: 0 by 0x0000f484 (0: 0..1, 1: 0..0x1e, 2: 0x1e..0x3c); 2 from the 4-pair table 0x0000ebe8 indexed by world_reversi_chain_index of the word at 0x0000f9dc or 0x0000f9e0; 3, 4 and 7 by 0x0000fcc4 (1: 0..0x14, else 0x32..end) and also set 0x0000fb0c = 0x10000, 0x0000fb14 = 0, 0x0000fb18 = -20.0; 6 by the intro phase 0x0000f480 (0: 0..0xe, 1: 0xd..0xe, 2: 0x14..0x1d); 8 by 0x0000f484 (1: 0x17..0x2e, else 0..0x17); others 0..end (-1). No return value. Side effects: the animation player, 0x0000fb0c..0x0000fb18. Callers: 6 (world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_show_reject_anim, world_reversi_show_chain_anim, world_reversi_show_banner, ...).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_anim(void *list, int anim, int advance)
column3: Draws animation anim with its EHF parameter block (0x0000f420 for anims 0, 5, 6, 8; 0x0000fa40 for 1; 0x0000faa0 for 2; 0x0000fb00 for 3, 4, 7): the block's frame word is the frame timing when advance is 1, otherwise it holds the player's current frame (ui_ehf_get_player_field_1c) once the range end is reached; draws between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra drops it). Side effects: the display list, the parameter block. Callers: 5 (world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_reject_anim, world_reversi_draw_chain_anim, ...).

True when the animation's current frame equals the last frame of its play range (end - 1). No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_reversi_draw_anim, world_reversi_draw_intro, world_reversi_draw_reject_anim, world_reversi_draw_chain_anim, ...).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_number_large(void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Binds gim 7 and draws value as 10x12 digit sprites (u = 0x1c + digit * 10, v 0x74) from x leftwards, 10 pixels per digit. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_status_panel).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_number_small(void *list, int x, int y, int value)
column3: Binds gim 7 and draws value as 7x9 digit sprites (u = digit * 7, v 0x40) from x leftwards, 7 pixels per digit. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_team_result).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_portrait(void *list, uint character, int variant, int x, int y, int width, int height, int size)
column3: Draws a character face: for a named character the 40x40 cell (index world_get_character_byte_3f: column % 12, row / 12) of the face atlas gim world_reversi_get_face_gim_index(size), stretched to width x height at (x, y); for a generic character draws it with ui_call_draw_character_portrait_image (gims 5 and 6, scale width / 40) clipped by a scissor to the box. Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 3 (world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_selector_frame, world_reversi_draw_team_result).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_character_name(void *list, int character, int variant, int x, int y)
column3: Draws the character's name (the player's own name from the save for character 1, otherwise world_get_character_name_string(character, variant, 0)) in black with shadow at scale 13, fitted to 0x59 pixels at (x, y), restoring the font flags. The fifth argument travels in t0. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_status_panel).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper: system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1) (tail call; Ghidra shows an empty body). No return value. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_character_name). Same code as BOOT ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit.
Draws the screen fade on GE layer 5 (state 1 disabled, system_draw_fade). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 5. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw).

Intro screen on GE layer 4: an untextured white 480x272 sprite and, while bit 0 of 0x0000f488 is set, animation 6; when it reaches its range end the phase 0x0000f480 advances 0 -> 1 (new range), stays in 1 for 60 frames (counter 0x0000f484) then -> 2 (new range), and in phase 2 clears bit 0 of 0x0000f488 (intro finished). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, 0x0000f480/0x0000f484/0x0000f488. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw).

Draws the play screen by calling, in order, world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_selector_glows, world_reversi_draw_board, world_reversi_draw_reject_anim, world_reversi_draw_chain_anim, world_reversi_draw_selectors, world_reversi_draw_cursor_rings, world_reversi_draw_banner, world_reversi_draw_team_result, world_reversi_draw_score_panel and world_reversi_draw_continue_window. No return value. Side effects: GE display lists. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw).

On GE layer 4 draws the background gim 0 (480x256 plus the bottom strips), the two disc counts (world_reversi_count_discs) as small numbers at (0x1a, 0xd) and (0x1a, 0x83), the portraits and names of the four seats (seat 3, seat 2, the partner and the player, character 1 from 0x0000ec34; y positions from 0x0000ec08 and 0x0000ec18), a 0x38x0x18 label from gim 7 at (5, 0xf3) with the total score 0x0000f388 and the win counter 0x0000f38c as large numbers at (0x8e, 0xf3) and (0x8e, 0xff), then animation 0. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

Draws the 8x8 board: for every 12-byte cell of the board at 0x0000f4c8 (row * 0x60 + column * 0xc) whose disc frame word +4 is non-negative (v) draws the 32x32 cell (v & 3, v >> 2) of gim 1 (frames 0-8 animate a disc flipping from side 1 to side 2) at (0xcc + column * 32, 8 + row * 32) on GE layer 4. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

On GE layer 4 draws the selection frames: during the player's turn (0x0000f484 = 1) in phase 2, when side 1 has missed at least once (0x0000f9d4 > 0) and a previous column exists (0x0000f4bc >= 0), a pulsing (alpha 100 +- 50, period from 0x0000f4a0) frame-only marker on that column; then the active selectors (none before phase 2 or with no turn, the row selector in phase 2, row and column in phases 3-6), each with world_reversi_draw_selector_frame using its 0x14-byte cursor record at 0x0000f490 + i * 0x14 (position, target, slide timer, blink timer), the turn, the move result 0x0000f48c and blinking arrows in the player's phase 2. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

column2: void * world_reversi_draw_selector_frame(void *list, int frame_only, int axis, int pos, int target, int slide, int turn, int result, int blink, int blink_timer)
column3: Draws a 5-pixel-corner nine-slice frame from gim 7 over board row pos (axis 0, at x 0xca) or column pos (axis 1, at y 6), its size from the table 0x0000ec38..0x0000ec44, sliding 32 pixels towards target with ui_duel_ease_sine over 8 frames; unless frame_only, adds the chooser's badge beside it (0x23 box, 0x2d with filtering when result is non-zero): for turn 1 the player (character 1) on the row axis and the partner (0x0000f390/0x0000f394) on the column axis, for turn 2 the opponents 0x0000f398/0x0000f39c by axis, drawn with world_reversi_draw_portrait; with blink set adds two bobbing arrow sprites. Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3, 9-10 on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_selectors). Medium confidence for the argument roles.

While bit 0 of 0x0000fb60 is set draws animation 1 (parameter block 0x0000fa40, positioned by world_reversi_show_reject_anim) on GE layer 4 and clears the bit once it reaches its range end. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, 0x0000fb60. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

While bit 1 of 0x0000fb60 is set draws animation 2 (block 0x0000faa0, positioned by world_reversi_show_chain_anim) and clears the bit at its range end. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, 0x0000fb60. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

With additive blending draws, for each active selector record (row 0x0000f9f0, column 0x0000fa00: state, timer, scale, alpha), a 10x10 glow sprite (gim 7, u 0x5a) scaled to its base size (tables 0x0000ec48/0x0000ec50) times the record scale and tinted by its alpha, centred on the row (x 0x14c, y row * 32 + 0x18) or column (x column * 32 + 0xdc, y 0x88). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

For each of the three ring records at 0x0000fa10 (state, delay, size, alpha; 0x10 bytes) that is active and past its delay, draws a size x size nine-slice ring (gim 7, u 0x50) with that alpha centred on the cursor cell (column 0x0000f4a4, row 0x0000f490). No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

While bit 2 of 0x0000fb60 is set draws the banner animation 0x0000fba0 (world_reversi_draw_anim); at its range end the result banners 3, 4 and 7 in wait phase 1 (0x0000fcc4) are re-ranged to hold frame 0x14 and wait phase 2 is entered (a button press continues them), other banners clear the bit. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4, the animation, 0x0000fb60, 0x0000fcc4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).
While bit 3 of 0x0000fb60 is set draws the round score panel (world_reversi_draw_score_panel_contents) on GE layer 4. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).
While bit 4 of 0x0000fb60 is set draws the message window at 0x0000fba4 (world_reversi_draw_window) on GE layer 4. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

While a result banner (3, 4 or 7) is shown and its wait phase 0x0000fcc4 is non-zero, draws the two teams at y 0x98: the player and partner (characters from the table 0x0000ec58, partner 0x0000f390) and the two opponents (0x0000f398, 0x0000f39c), each with a 0x23 badge frame and a 32x32 portrait whose atlas size depends on the team's rank (1 for the side with more discs, 2 for fewer, 0 for a draw; world_reversi_count_discs), x positions from 0x0000ec78, plus the team's disc icon (gim 1, v 0 or 0x40) and its disc count in small digits at y 0xb1. No return value. Side effects: GE layer 4. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_game).

Prepares a round: clears the next-round bit 1 of 0x0000f408, clears the 0x850-byte play state at 0x0000f480 (phase, turn, cursors, board, flip list, counters, effect records), empties the board, sets the turn animation range, places the starting discs (side 1 at (3,3) and (4,4), side 2 at (3,4) and (4,3)), sets the four last-move words 0x0000f4b8..0x0000f4c4 to -1 and the phase 0x0000f480 to 0. No return value. Side effects: play state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).
Shows the start banner (world_reversi_show_banner(5)), sets the play phase 0x0000f480 to 1 and plays sound 0x7ac5. No return value. Side effects: play state, sound. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).

Play phase machine on 0x0000f480: 1 after the start banner sets turn 0x0000f484 = 1 (team of the player), phase 2, resets both AIs and plays track 0x1b; 2 after any banner, when the row is chosen (world_reversi_select_axis(1)) starts the row selector, -> 3; 3 when the row selector is shown and the column is chosen starts the column selector and the cursor rings, records the move as the side's last move (0x0000f4b8/0x0000f4bc or 0x0000f4c0/0x0000f4c4), -> 4; 4 when the rings settle places the disc: on an occupied cell rejects the move (result 0x0000f48c = 2, -> 6); otherwise collects the flips: with flips -> 5; without flips the disc stays when it touches any disc (-> 6), else it is removed and rejected; plays 0x7ac8 (accepted) or 0x7a18 (rejected), updates the miss and chain counters, shows the chain animation and plays the chain sound from 0x0000ec98 for chains of 2 or more (result 1), fades out the selectors and ends the rings; 5 runs the flip sequence, -> 6; 6 when nothing is animating: if an empty cell remains switches the turn (1 <-> 2), resets both AIs (the partner keeps its chosen move), shows banner 8, plays 0x7a22, -> 2; else ends the game (turn 0, world_reversi_finish_game, sound 0x7acc, track 5), -> 7; 7 while the result banner waits handles its button, then by outcome 0x0000f488: 3 draw opens the continue window -> 9, 2 loss -> 10, 1 win shows the score panel -> 8; 8 when the score has been added hides the panel and opens the continue window -> 9; 9 sets bit 1 of 0x0000f408 when Continue was chosen (cleared on Quit) -> 10; 10 returns 1. In phases 1-9 the disc, selector and ring animations are stepped every frame. Returns 1 in phase 10, else 0. Side effects: play state, board, sounds, BGM. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).
Returns 2 when side is 1, otherwise 1. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_reversi_collect_flips, world_reversi_count_flips, world_reversi_sim_apply_flips).
Sets all 64 board cells (0x0000f4c8, 12 bytes each, row stride 0x60) to state 0, disc frame -1 and timer 0. No return value. Side effects: the board. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_setup_board).

column2: int world_reversi_place_disc(int side, int row, int col)
column3: When cell (row, col) is empty puts a disc of side there: side 1 as state 1 with frame 0, any other side as state 3 with frame 8; returns 1. Returns 0 for an occupied cell. Side effects: the board. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_setup_board, world_reversi_update_play).

Starts flipping the disc at (row, col): a side-2 disc (state 2 or 3) becomes state 4 (turning to side 1, frame 8 counting down), a side-1 disc (state 1 or 4) becomes state 2 (turning to side 2, frame 0 counting up); clears the timer and plays sound 0x7ac7. No return value. Side effects: the board, sound. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_step_flip_sequence).

Returns the state word of board cell (row, col) at 0x0000f4c8 + row * 0x60 + col * 0xc (0 empty, 1 side 1, 2 turning to side 2, 3 side 2, 4 turning to side 1). No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_reversi_is_occupied, world_reversi_get_cell_side, world_reversi_has_empty_cell, world_reversi_count_occupied, ...).

Reads the cell state (world_reversi_get_cell_state) and returns 0x00003b64(row, col, state), which callers treat as the owning side 0/1/2 (hypothesis: states 1 and 4 map to side 1, 2 and 3 to side 2, medium; 0x00003b64 itself decompiles to an empty body). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_reversi_scan_direction, world_reversi_count_discs, world_reversi_finish_game, world_reversi_ai_score_cell).

column2: int world_reversi_state_to_side(int row, int col, int state)
column3: Maps a cell state (third argument, a2; row and col are ignored) to the owning side: 0 -> 0 (empty), 1 -> 1, 2 -> 2, 3 -> 2, 4 -> 1 (states 3 and 4 are the flipping states, confirming the earlier hypothesis); any other state returns v0 unchanged (undefined). The decompiler shows an empty body because every result is set in a branch delay slot. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_reversi_get_cell_side, world_reversi_sim_flip_direction, world_reversi_sim_test_line).

column2: void world_reversi_reject_move(int row, int col, int clear)
column3: Rejects a move: when clear is 0 empties cell (row, col) (the just-placed disc), then shows the reject animation at the cursor cell's screen position (world_reversi_show_reject_anim(col * 32 + 0xdc, row * 32 + 0x18)). No return value. Side effects: the board, animation state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
True when 0 <= row < 8 and 0 <= col < 8. No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_reversi_is_occupied, world_reversi_scan_direction, world_reversi_sim_flip_direction, 0x000044ec).
True when any of the eight neighbours (offsets from the table 0x0000eca8) is on the board and occupied. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_update_play, world_reversi_ai_score_cell).
True when (row, col) is on the board and its cell state is non-zero. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_has_neighbour).

column2: void world_reversi_collect_flips(int side, int row, int col)
column3: Clears the flip count 0x0000f7c8 and, for each of the eight directions, appends the opponent discs bracketed by a disc of side from (row, col) (world_reversi_scan_direction with copy-out) to the {row, col} list at 0x0000f7d4, adding their number to 0x0000f7c8. No return value. Side effects: 0x0000f7c8, the flip list. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

column2: int world_reversi_scan_direction(int other_side, int row, int col, int d_row, int d_col, void *out)
column3: Steps from (row, col) by (d_row, d_col) collecting cells while they belong to other_side; returns the number collected when the run ends on a disc of the other colour (and, when out is non-null, copies the {row, col} pairs there), or 0 when it leaves the board or reaches an empty cell. Arguments 5-6 travel in t0/t1. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_collect_flips, world_reversi_count_flips).

Copies two words from src to dest and returns dest (here a {row, col} pair of the flip list). Side effects: writes dest[0..1]. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_scan_direction). Same code as rel_duel_draw ui_copy_duel_ui_mode_state.

column2: int world_reversi_count_flips(int side, int row, int col)
column3: Returns the number of discs a move of side at (row, col) would flip: the sum of world_reversi_scan_direction over the eight directions without copy-out. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_ai_score_cell).

column2: void world_reversi_sim_apply_flips(int side, int row, int col, void *board)
column3: On a board copy applies the flips of a move of side at (row, col) in all eight directions (world_reversi_sim_flip_direction with the other side). No return value. Side effects: writes board. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_sim_is_capturable). Medium confidence (callee reads hidden arguments).

column2: void world_reversi_sim_flip_direction(int other_side, int row, int col, int d_row, int d_col, void *board)
column3: On a board copy (same 12-byte cell layout) walks one direction over other_side's cells and, when the run is closed by the mover's disc, sets those cells to the mover's state (3 when other_side is 1, else 1). Arguments 5-6 travel in t0/t1. No return value. Side effects: writes board. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_sim_apply_flips). Medium confidence (the cell reads go through 0x00003b64 with hidden arguments).

column2: bool world_reversi_sim_is_capturable(int side, int row, int col)
column3: Copies the board (0x300 bytes) to the stack, applies the move of side at (row, col) to the copy and returns true when any of the eight lines through (row, col) tested by 0x000044ec reports the side's run as open at one end and closed by the opponent at the other (hypothesis: the new disc could be captured next turn, medium). Side effects: none on the real board. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_ai_score_cell).

column2: int world_reversi_sim_test_line(int side, int row, int col, int d_row, int d_col, void *board)
column3: On a board copy (12-byte cells, 0x60 bytes per row, state word at +0) tests the line through (row, col) in direction (d_row, d_col): walks forward from the next cell while the cells belong to side (world_reversi_state_to_side), then backward from the previous cell the same way; returns 0 when either walk leaves the board. Otherwise returns 1 when exactly one end of the run is empty and the other holds an opponent disc (the run could be captured by a move at the empty end), else 0. Arguments 5-6 travel in t0/t1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_sim_is_capturable).
Clears the flip-list index 0x0000f7cc and the step delay 0x0000f7d0. No return value. Side effects: those words. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

While listed flips remain (index 0x0000f7cc < count 0x0000f7c8) waits 5 frames (0x0000f7d0) then flips the next listed disc (world_reversi_flip_disc) and returns 0; returns 1 when the list is exhausted. Side effects: the board, list index and delay. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
True when any of the 64 cells has state 0 (the game ends only when the board is full). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Counts the cells owned by side 1 (out[0]) and side 2 (out[1]) with world_reversi_get_cell_side. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_draw_status_panel, world_reversi_draw_team_result).
Returns the number of non-empty cells. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_ai_build_path).

For the side to move (0x0000f9d4 for turn 1, 0x0000f9d8 otherwise) increments the consecutive-miss counter when rejected is 1, else clears it. No return value. Side effects: the counter. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

For the side to move (0x0000f9dc for turn 1, 0x0000f9e0 otherwise): when accepted is 1 increments the chain counter up to 5 and, for side 1 with a chain of 2 or more, adds (flip count 0x0000f7c8 + chain * 10) * 10 to the bonus 0x0000f9ec; otherwise clears the chain. No return value. Side effects: the counters, bonus. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Steps every cell's disc animation: state 4 lowers the frame by one every 2 frames until 0, then becomes 1; state 2 raises it every 2 frames to 8, then becomes 3; states 3, 1 and 0 pin the frame at 8, 0 and -1. No return value. Side effects: the board. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Updates the row (row_axis 1: record 0x0000f490, Up 0x10 / Down 0x40) or column (record 0x0000f4a4, Left 0x80 / Right 0x20) cursor {position, target, slide timer, blink timers}: when not sliding reads input from the pad for the player's row on turn 1, from world_reversi_partner_ai_input for the column on turn 1 (the partner's choice) and from world_reversi_opponent_ai_input on turn 2 (the opponents); the confirm button (system_get_confirm_button) returns 1 with sound 0x7a05; Up/Down or Left/Right start an 8-frame slide to the neighbouring line with wrap-around and sound 0x7a04; also steps the blink timers (periods 0x10 and 0x20). Returns 1 when the line was confirmed, else 0. Side effects: the cursor record, sounds. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

True while any disc is flipping (state 2 or 4), the reject or chain animation runs (bits 0-1 of 0x0000fb60), a selector glow is not idle or the cursor rings are not idle. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Stores (x, y) as floats in the parameter block of animation 1 (0x0000fa54/0x0000fa58), sets its +0xc word to 0x10000, sets bit 0 of 0x0000fb60 and sets the animation's range. No return value. Side effects: animation state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_reject_move).
Same for animation 2 (0x0000fab4/0x0000fab8, bit 1 of 0x0000fb60), the range chosen by the chain length. No return value. Side effects: animation state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Sets the selector glow record (0x0000f9f0 for the row, 0x0000fa00 for the column) to state 1 with timer, scale and alpha 0. No return value. Side effects: the record. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
Sets the selector glow record to state 3 (fading), timer 0, scale 1.0, alpha 100. No return value. Side effects: the record. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Returns the state word of the row (0x0000f9f0) or column (0x0000fa00) selector glow (0 idle, 1 growing, 2 shown, 3 fading). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_update_play, world_reversi_is_busy).

Steps both selector glows: state 1 grows scale = sin(K * t / 8) over 8 frames (alpha = scale * 100), then state 2 (scale 1.0, alpha 100); state 3 keeps scale 1.0 and fades alpha = (1 - sin(K * t / 8)) * 100 over 8 frames, then state 0. No return value. Side effects: the records. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Starts the three cursor rings (records 0x0000fa10 + i * 0x10): state 1, delay counter -2 * i, size 0x30, alpha 0x80. No return value. Side effects: the records. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
Puts the first ring into the fade state 3 (size 0x20, alpha 0xff, counter 0) and switches the other two off. No return value. Side effects: the records. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
Returns 1 or 3 when the first ring found in that state is 1 or 3, 2 when all three rings are in state 2, otherwise 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_update_play, world_reversi_is_busy).

Steps the three rings: state 1 shrinks the size from 0x30 to 0x20 and raises the alpha from 0x80 to 0xff over 5 frames, then state 2 (0x20, 0xff); state 3 fades the alpha from 0xff to 0 over 8 frames, then state 0. No return value. Side effects: the records. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

An 8-byte stub that tail-jumps into world_reversi_set_anim_range with animation 0 (Ghidra shows the inlined body): seeks the turn-indicator animation 0 and sets its range by the turn 0x0000f484 (0: frames 0..1, 1: 0..0x1e, 2: 0x1e..0x3c). No return value. Side effects: the animation player. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_setup_board, world_reversi_update_play).

Sets bit 2 of 0x0000fb60, stores anim in 0x0000fba0, sets the wait phase 0x0000fcc4 to 1 for the result banners 3, 4 and 7 (0 otherwise) and sets the animation's range (world_reversi_set_anim_range). No return value. Side effects: banner state. Callers: 3 (world_reversi_start_play, world_reversi_update_play, world_reversi_finish_game).

While a result banner (3, 4, 7) holds in wait phase 2, a press of the confirm or the cancel button (system_get_confirm_button(0) and (1)) clears the wait phase, lets the banner play out (world_reversi_set_anim_range) and plays sound 0x7a05. No return value. Side effects: banner state, sound. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Counts the discs of both sides: more for side 1 shows banner 7 and sets the outcome 0x0000f488 = 1 (win), fewer shows banner 4 (outcome 2, loss), equal banner 3 (outcome 3, draw); on a win increments the win counter 0x0000f38c (capped at 999999999); sets the disc score 0x0000f9e8 = side-1 discs * 50 and the round score 0x0000f9e4 = (K * wins + 1.0) * (disc score + bonus 0x0000f9ec), K the float at 0x0000e7b4. No return value. Side effects: outcome, counters, banner. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
Maps a chain length to an index: 2..5 -> 0..3, anything else 0. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_set_anim_range, world_reversi_update_play).

Opens the round score panel (world_reversi_score_panel_init with the multiplier K * wins + 1.0, the disc score 0x0000f9e8, the bonus 0x0000f9ec and the round score 0x0000f9e4) and sets bit 3 of 0x0000fb60. No return value. Side effects: panel state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).
Clears bit 3 of 0x0000fb60. No return value. Side effects: that bit. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Runs world_reversi_score_panel_update on the total score 0x0000f388 (hypothesis: counts the round score into it and reports 1 when finished, medium; the caller tests the return value although Ghidra shows none) and clamps the total to 999999999. Side effects: 0x0000f388. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Sets bit 4 of 0x0000fb60 and opens the message window at 0x0000fba4 with string 2 of strTbl.bin (world_reversi_open_window(window, text, 3, 2)). No return value. Side effects: window state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Polls the window 0x0000fba4 (world_reversi_update_window): result 2 returns 0 (continue), 3 or -2 return 1 (quit), anything else -1 (still open). Side effects: through the window update. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Clears the 0x1c-byte partner-AI state at 0x0000fb64 (step, path index, path length, column path, chosen move) and sets 0x0000fb78 and 0x0000fb7c to -1. No return value. Side effects: AI state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Clears the partner-AI state at 0x0000fb64 but preserves the chosen move (0x0000fb78 row, 0x0000fb7c column), which the partner reuses after a miss when it still scores best. No return value. Side effects: AI state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play).

Produces the partner's column input on the player's turn, by step 0x0000fb64: 0 chooses the best move for side 1 with the partner's weights (world_reversi_ai_choose_move(1, ..., 0x0000f3a8)), keeps it in 0x0000fb78/0x0000fb7c and builds a column path to its column (world_reversi_ai_build_path into 0x0000fb70, length 0x0000fb6c), -> 1; 1 returns Right (0x20) or Left (0x80) until the column cursor 0x0000f4a4 reaches the current path entry, then advances to the next entry, -> 2 after the last; 2 returns the confirm button. The partner aims at the best move on the whole board, not in the row the player chose. Returns the synthesised button bits (0 when idle). Side effects: partner-AI state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_select_axis).

Clears the 0x20-byte opponent-AI state at 0x0000fb80 (step, path index, path lengths, row and column paths). No return value. Side effects: that state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play, at the start of play).
Same body as world_reversi_opponent_ai_reset: clears the opponent-AI state at 0x0000fb80. No return value. Side effects: that state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update_play, on every turn switch).

Produces the opponents' row and column input on turn 2, by step 0x0000fb80: 0 when world_reversi_ai_opponents_cooperate is false, opponent A (weights 0x0000f3c8) chooses the row and opponent B (0x0000f3e8) the column independently (each through world_reversi_ai_choose_move for side 2); when true one opponent picked at random chooses both; builds a row path (0x0000fb90, length 0x0000fb88) and a column path (0x0000fb98, length 0x0000fb8c), -> 1; 1 returns Down (0x40) or Up (0x10) until the row cursor 0x0000f490 has visited the row path, then returns confirm, -> 2; 2 returns Right/Left (0x20/0x80) along the column path, -> 3; 3 returns confirm. Returns the synthesised button bits. Side effects: opponent-AI state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_select_axis).

column2: void world_reversi_ai_best_in_row(int side, int row, int *out_col, int *out_score, int *weights)
column3: Scores the eight cells of row for side (world_reversi_ai_score_cell) paired with random tie-break keys and stores the column with the best pair in *out_col and its {score, key} in out_score (world_reversi_ai_pick_max). The fifth argument travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_ai_choose_move).

column2: void world_reversi_ai_choose_move(int side, int *out_row, int *out_col, int *out_score, int *weights)
column3: Finds each row's best column (world_reversi_ai_best_in_row), then the best row by {score, random key}; stores the row, its column and the score. For side 1 (the partner), after a miss (0x0000f9d4 > 0) it keeps its previous target 0x0000fb78/0x0000fb7c when that cell still has the same score. weights is the character's 8-word reversi table (world_get_character_words_58 cached at 0x0000f3a8/0x0000f3c8/0x0000f3e8). The fifth argument travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_partner_ai_input, world_reversi_opponent_ai_input).

column2: void world_reversi_ai_pick_max(int *out_index, int *out_value, int *pairs, int count)
column3: Returns in *out_index and *out_value the index and first word of the {value, key} pair with the highest value among count pairs, ties going to the larger key. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_ai_best_in_row, world_reversi_ai_choose_move).

column2: int world_reversi_ai_score_cell(int side, int row, int col, int *weights)
column3: AI value of a move: -1 when the cell is occupied or has no occupied neighbour (illegal under this game's rule); otherwise with n = world_reversi_count_flips(side, row, col): a corner scores weights[0] + weights[1] * n; an edge cell not next to a corner (row or column 0/7, the other coordinate not 1/6) that cannot be recaptured (world_reversi_sim_is_capturable, always tested for side 1) scores weights[2] + weights[3] * n; other cells weights[6] + weights[7] * n when n < 5, else weights[4] + weights[5] * n; each clamped to 0..100000. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_ai_best_in_row, world_reversi_ai_choose_move).
Clamps value to 0..100000. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_ai_score_cell).

column2: int world_reversi_ai_build_path(int unused, int target, int *out)
column3: Builds the cursor stops the AI visits before confirming: while fewer than 63 cells are occupied, 1 or 2 stops at random (the first a random line 0..7 as a feint), otherwise 1; the last stop is target. Returns the number of stops. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 2 (world_reversi_partner_ai_input, world_reversi_opponent_ai_input).

Decides whether one opponent chooses the whole move this turn, by the round counter 0x0000f384 and the opponents' miss count 0x0000f9d8: round 1 only after 3 misses, round 2 after 3 misses or 1 in 5, round 3 after 2 misses or 1 in 4, round 4 after 1 miss or 1 in 3, round 5 and later always. Returns the decision. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_opponent_ai_input).

column2: void world_reversi_score_panel_init(float multiplier, int disc_score, int bonus, int round_score)
column3: Clears the 0x1c-byte score-panel state at 0x0020fcd0 (just past the module heap) and stores disc_score (+4), bonus (+8), multiplier (+0xc, float in f12) and round_score (+0x10, the amount still to transfer). No return value. Side effects: the panel state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_show_score_panel).

Steps the score panel 0x0020fcd0: 0 fades its alpha (+0x14) in by the step at 0x0000e7bc, -> 1; 1 after 30 frames waits for the confirm button, -> 2; 2 transfers points into *total (world_reversi_score_panel_transfer) until none remain, -> 3; 3 waits 30 frames, -> 4; 4 fades out and returns 1 when the alpha reaches 0. Returns 1 when finished, else 0. Side effects: panel state, *total. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_add_round_score).

Draws the round score panel with its alpha: two dark rectangles, three grey rules (y 0x5a, 0x96, 0xb4), then strTbl.bin words with numbers at scale 15: title word 6 at (0x73, 0x46) at scale 18; word 1 with the disc score (y 100), word 3 with the bonus (y 0x82), word 8 with their sum, unit word 4 and the multiplier printed with the format at 0x0000ece8 (y 0xa0), and in yellow word 7 with the remaining round score and unit word 5 (y 0xbe); values right-aligned at x 0x172. No return value. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_score_panel).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Draws text from pixel x to the right screen edge: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text) (tail call). No return value. Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_score_panel_contents). Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text.

Takes points from the panel's remaining round score 0x0020fce0: 10 per frame, or everything when the confirm button is pressed or fewer than 10 remain; plays sound 0x7a90. Returns the amount taken. Side effects: 0x0020fce0, sound. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_score_panel_update).

column2: void * ui_call_draw_sprite_region(void *list, int x, int y, int u, int v, int width, int height)
column3: Draws the texture rectangle (u, v, width x height) unscaled at (x, y) through ui_draw_sprite_region (destination size = source size; arguments 5-7 in t0-t2). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_score_panel_contents). Same code as rel_duel_draw ui_call_draw_sprite_region.

column2: void ui_draw_sprite_region(void *list, int x, int y, int u, int v, int src_width, int src_height, int width, int height)
column3: Draws the texture region (u, v, src_width x src_height) of the bound texture at (x, y) stretched to width x height (ninth argument on the stack). No return value. Side effects: GE commands. Callers: 1 (ui_call_draw_sprite_region). Same code as rel_duel_draw ui_draw_sprite_region.

Clears the phase, turn and outcome words 0x0000f480..0x0000f48b, sets bit 0 of 0x0000f488 (intro running) and sets the range of the intro animation 6. No return value. Side effects: those words, the animation. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).
True when bit 0 of 0x0000f488 is clear (world_reversi_draw_intro clears it). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update).

column2: void world_reversi_open_window(void *window, ushort *text, int choices, uchar default_choice)
column3: Fills a 0x120-byte list window (type 1, modal, margins 10/10/8/0, text, shadow, ruby when the language is Japanese, font size 0xd, black text, choice count choices and default default_choice in the bit fields +0xca/+0xd3, style byte +0xd4 = 3 for three choices else 4, heap from world_reversi_get_heap), opens it (ui_open_list_window), centres it on the 480 x 272 screen and centres the text horizontally inside its inner rectangle. No return value. Side effects: the window, font state. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_open_continue_window).
Updates the list window (ui_update_list_window) and resets it once the result is not -1. Returns the result (-1 while open). Side effects: the window. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_get_continue_choice).
Draws the list window into list (ui_draw_list_window). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw_continue_window).
Clears the 0x150-byte menu context and stores archive in its first word. No return value. Side effects: writes ctx. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_create). Copy of rel_title ui_menu_ctx_init.

column2: ushort * ui_reversi_menu_ctx_get_message(void *ctx, int table_base, int table_offset, uint index)
column3: Returns string index of mini_result message table table_base + table_offset (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_get_message_table_name) from the context's archive (ui_reversi_get_archive_dictionary_word). Side effects: none. Callers: 3 (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_draw_number, ui_reversi_result_handle_input, ui_reversi_result_draw_labels). Copy of rel_title ui_menu_ctx_get_message.

Copies the 0x20-byte member name index (< 0x12) from the name array at 0x0000ecf4 (mini_result_j.bin first) into out. Returns true when index < 0x12. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_get_message). Copy of rel_title ui_menu_ctx_get_message_table_name.

Finds member in the EHP archive and returns string index of that string table (card_db_get_dictionary_word). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_get_message). Copy of rel_title ui_get_archive_dictionary_word.

Looks up image index in the context's archive by name from the 0x40-byte name array at 0x0000ef34 (result_mini01.gim first, 5 entries). Returns the member pointer. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_bind_image). Copy of rel_title ui_menu_ctx_find_image.
Caches image index at ctx + 0x13c + index * 4. No return value. Side effects: writes ctx. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_init). Copy of rel_title ui_menu_ctx_bind_image.

column2: void ui_reversi_result_create(void *heap, void *archive, int game, uint *score)
column3: Allocates the 0x2c4-byte mini-game result block from heap (pointer 0x0020fcec), clears it, stores heap, initialises its menu context (+0x54) with archive, stores the game index (+0x20), applies the score when given (ui_reversi_result_apply_score) and initialises the screen (ui_reversi_result_init). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x0020fcec, save (through the score routine). Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update), which passes game 5 and the total score 0x0000f388. Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_create.

When the result block 0x0020fcec exists, resets its list window (+0x1a4), frees it on its heap and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x0020fcec. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_destroy.

Scores a finished mini-game into the result block 0x0020fcec and the save, exactly as rel_title ui_mini_result_apply_score: stores the score values (+0x28 / +0x2c / +0x40) and the main score in world_get_minigame_score(); base DP (+0x30) per game 0 score / 50, 1 / 150, 2 score / 2 plus ceil(score[1] / 100) when score[2] is set, 3 / 10, 4 score[1] * 20 + score[2] * 150, 5 / 50, 6 / 10; each new record (records 0, 1, 2+3, 6, 5+4, 7, 8 for games 0-6) adds 200 DP, stores it and sets +0x44/+0x46 and the save record-table byte +0xec + record; total +0x38, EXP +0x3c = total / 25, save_add_dp, save_add_duelist_exp and 400 DP more on a level up; games 3 and 4 store the from-story flag +0x1c. rel_reversi passes game 5 (record 7, DP score / 50). No return value. Side effects: the result block, save records, DP, EXP, the world score. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_create). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_apply_score.

Binds the result screen's context layouts (0: frames 0..0x10, 1: 0..0x1df) and images 0 and 1 in the context at 0x0020fcec + 0x54, sets step +0xc = 1 and starts a 16-frame black fade in. No return value. Side effects: the result block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_create). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_init.

Returns ui_reversi_result_update_main() while mode +8 of the block 0x0020fcec is 0, otherwise 1. Side effects: through the update. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_update). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update.

Step handler of the result screen (+0xc): 0/1 wait for the fade, 2 the intro, 3 input, 4 the message window, 5 reads layout 0's frame, 6 returns the outcome +0x24 (2 play again, 3 leave). Returns 1 while running, 0 for unknown steps. Side effects: through the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_update). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update_main.

Step 2: when context layout 0 reaches frame 0x10 switches it to the loop 0x11..0x60; from frame 0x10 on sets step 3. No return value. Side effects: the layout, step. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_wait_intro.

Step 3: on a face button: when launched from the story (+0x1c == 1, only set for games 3 and 4, so never for reversi) sets outcome 3, fades the BGM, plays layout 0 frames 0x61..0x65, step 5 and a black fade out; otherwise step 4, outcome 3 and a three-choice modal message window with mini_result string 0xd (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_open_message_window on window +0x1a4). No return value. Side effects: the block, window, BGM, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_handle_input.

True when any face button (pad pressed bits 0xf000) was pressed, playing sound 0x7a05. Side effects: sound. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_handle_input). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_poll_face_buttons.

Step 4: updates the window +0x1a4; result 2 sets the outcome +0x24 = 2 (play again), 3 or -2 sets 3; when the window has closed (state byte +0x28d == 6) plays layout 0 frames 0x36..0x65, sets step 5, fades out and fades the BGM. No return value. Side effects: the block, layout, fade, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_update_main). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_update_message_window.

Tail-jumps to the layout-frame getter on layout 0 of the context (a0 = context + 0x54, a1 = 0), so it returns that frame; the decompiler drops the jump and shows nothing returned, and the caller ignores the value. Copy of the rel_title routine without its compare with 0x65. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_update_main).

Draws the result screen: context layout 1, layout 0 from step 2, the header, panels and labels/values, the message window centred at step 4; drives the fades (step 5 -> 6 and step 1 -> 2). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, step. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw.

At steps 3 and 4, with context image 1 bound, draws its panel part 0xd at (0x70, 8). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_header.

With context image 0 bound draws the result panels (border box, two sections with title bars, value boxes and two rows each, the new-record marks for +0x44/+0x46, two three-slice bars with value boxes, the bottom bar). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_panels.

Draws the result texts from mini_result_<l>.bin (section titles 1/3, headers 2/5, row labels by game +0x20, 8/9 with unit 0xe, totals 10/11 with units 0xe/0xf, footer 0xc) and then the values (ui_reversi_result_draw_values). Returns the advanced display list (Ghidra drops it). Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_draw). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_labels.

Draws the six result values (+0x28..+0x3c) right-aligned at x 0x155 with digit strings from 0x15 (ui_reversi_menu_ctx_draw_number); the second value only for game 2 (as a time) and game 4 (when +0x40 is set). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_draw_labels). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_draw_values.

True when the mini-game scene (0x15 for game 4, 0x18 for game 3, 0 otherwise) was called from scene 2; false when called from scene 0xd or anything else. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_reversi_result_apply_score). Copy of rel_title ui_mini_result_is_from_story.

column2: void world_reversi_pick_random_opponent(short scene, int *out_character, int *out_variant, int partner, int partner_variant, int *exclude, int exclude_count)
column3: Picks a random opponent: candidates are characters 0..0x8e that exist, are not the partner, are not in exclude[0..exclude_count), have a partner deck (world_character_has_partner_deck) and are not 0 or 1; the special characters 0x18, 0x1a, 0x1b, 0x21, 0x25, 0x27-0x29, 0x2b-0x2d and 0x79-0x7e also need a met variant (save_test_character_flag_bit0). Arguments 5-7 travel in t0-t2. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_reversi_setup_characters), with scene 0x19, no exclusions for seat 2 and seat 2's character excluded for seat 3.
